name: How much does it cost to build a custom home in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to build a custom home in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of building a custom home in Los Angeles varies widely due to land values, square footage, architectural complexity, material finishes, and permits. Generally, luxury custom homes in this region can range from $400 to over $1000 per square foot, excluding land acquisition costs. This estimate includes design, engineering, construction, and basic landscaping. A detailed budget is developed during the design phase to align with your specific vision and financial parameters, ensuring transparency throughout the process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom home costs in Los Angeles range from $400 to over $1000 per square foot, excluding land, depending on design and finishes.
